thread:
alex_devex: FYI — onboarding sample app failing. node SDK call to admin rollout returns 404, but curling REST works. looks like SDK doesn't surface /v1/admin/beta/rollouts.

maria_sdk: oof. can you paste quick repro (curl + node)?

alex_devex: sure:
```
# curl works
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/beta/rollouts \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","canary":true}'
# -> 200 {"id":"r123"}
```
```
// node sdk (broken)
await client.admin.beta.rollouts.create({model:"redwood-large", canary:true})
// -> SDKError: 404 Not Found
```

kevin_backend: I can reproduce. Appears the OpenAPI generator didn't include the 'admin/beta' namespace in the client. Also saw a param rename: REST uses `canary` but SDK generator expected `isCanary` in some versions.

maria_sdk: yeah our generator has a mapping table that missed beta names. Also note SDK retry surface: the JS client retries POSTs by default under `optimisticRetry`. For rollouts that's unsafe — we retried twice and the REST endpoint returned 409 on the second attempt.

alex_devex: customer impact: sample-app onboarding stalls, support ticket #7890. workaround is call REST directly or set `client.transport.raw('/v1/admin/beta/rollouts', ...)`.

samir_support: high priority for the sample app tutorial. can we ship a hotfix? :facepalm: 

maria_sdk: plan: I will update the generator's namespace mapping and param aliasing today, add unit test to cover nested admin paths.

kevin_backend: I'll change default retry behavior for non-idempotent endpoints — add a method-safety check so POSTs don't get retried unless `idempotencyKey` is provided. I'll open PR.

maria_sdk: opened PR #4321 linking to internal issue https://redwood-internal/issue/SDK-1234

ci-bot: CI: test run triggered for PR #4321 — build 548 -> ✅

alex_devex: I'll patch sample-app to call REST until SDK update is released; will file a docs note for onboarding.

samir_support: thx — keep me posted.

maria_sdk: ETA for release: today -> canary this afternoon.

kevin_backend: after PR merge I'll add an integration test that calls the generated client against a local express mock to prevent regressions.

alex_devex: great. marking this thread resolved for now. :thumbsup:
